title: Monthly bone mineral density loss in spaceflight, by skeletal region

source.name: Bone mineral and lean tissue loss after long duration spaceflight (LeBlanc et al.)
source.publisher: Journal of Musculoskeletal and Neuronal Interactions (NASA-funded spaceflight bone research)

notes: Weight-bearing regions (trochanter/hip, spine, pelvis) lose bone mineral density fastest during spaceflight, while non-weight-bearing regions like the forearm -- which do little structural work against gravity even on Earth -- show minimal change. Figures reflect the range widely reported across long-duration ISS crew bone-density studies.
